notes.title: Updated to 1.0.1.02
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where some text was not switch until restarting after switching languages.
[*] Fixed a bug where some text was displayed in the Japanese when selecting the language specification ENGLISH.
[*] Fixed a bug that could prevent attacks under certain conditions while playing with the controller.
[*] Fixed a bug that the menu may not be displayed correctly.
[/list]
